## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `cd5fafdb7da7fbb2c8c3c9d0b52eae9f542fd0ba`

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`SessionUserSchema.image`: `z.string().optional()` → `z.string().nullish()`** (`packages/spec/src/api/auth.zod.ts:47`, `.describe('Avatar URL')` kept) — **right**. It is the ruled edit (batch #138 item 1, 「138 同意」): `.nullish()`, not `.nullable()`. Proven both directions on my own instrument (`probe.ts`, tsx, base schema from `git show bf61f0a196:…` vs head): the `null` row moved FAIL→pass; the ABSENT row and explicit-`undefined` row pass on BOTH base and head, so the legal 「key absent」 shape is retained; `.nullable()` would have reddened the ABSENT row and did not.
2. **`SessionResponseSchema.data.user.image` accept set gains `null`** — **right**; it is the embedding of judgment 1 and the card's measured defect path (`data.user.image [invalid_type] expected string, received null` on base, `[]` on head — message matches the card verbatim).
3. **`UserProfileResponseSchema.data.image` accept set gains `null`** — **right**. Same declaration, second embedding (`auth.zod.ts:131 data: SessionUserSchema`); 「the one declaration」 reaches every embedding of it by construction. Probe: base FAIL, head pass; `42` still refused on both.
4. **Published TypeScript type `SessionUser['image']` widens `string | undefined` → `string | null | undefined`** — **right**. Packed d.ts/d.mts: `image: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodNullable<z.ZodString>>` ×3 (schema + both embeddings); `image: z.ZodOptional<z.ZodString>` ×1 (RegisterRequest). All four CI Type Check lanes green on this head; in-repo runtime readers of `.image` on a SessionUser-typed value: **0** (population sweep of plugin-auth, plugin-hono-server, client, cli src; every hit is a comment, a whitelist string, or the client's own already-`string | null` raw types at `index.ts:1066/:1270/:4592`); runtime `.parse/.safeParse` callers of the three widened schemas: **0** (lit: 2 test files). Runtime bytes do not change — better-auth served `null` before this PR; only the declaration moves.
5. **`RegisterRequestSchema.image` (`auth.zod.ts:111`) left as `z.string().optional()`** — **right, and the ruling does not reach it.** Decided independently: it sits under `// Requests` (banner at :92-94); its only consumer is `packages/client/src/index.ts:4463 register: async (request: RegisterRequest): Promise<SessionResponse>`, which `JSON.stringify`s the **caller's** object to better-auth `/sign-up/email` — the caller authors the value, better-auth consumes it; `packages/cli/src/commands/register.ts` builds the payload from `email/name/password` flags with no `image` at all; runtime parsers of `RegisterRequestSchema`: **0** (the only `.parse` hits are spec's own `auth.test.ts:252-282`). Probe on head: `RegisterRequest.image=null` still refused, identical to base. Widening it would be an unruled input-surface accept-set change with its own Clause-② weight. The round did not do less than the card needs.
6. **JSON Schema `json-schema/api/SessionUser.json` `image` → `{"description":"Avatar URL","anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"null"}]}`**, mirrored under `SessionResponse` and `UserProfileResponse`; `RegisterRequest.json` `image` stays `{"type":"string"}` — **right**. Build output (not tracked), re-derived on the tarball.
7. **Generated reference `content/docs/references/api/auth.mdx`**: rows `:159` (SessionUser Properties) and `:204` (`UserProfileResponse.data`) → `string \| null`; row `:92` (RegisterRequest) unchanged `string` — **right**; at merge base all three read `string`. Commit `cd5fafdb` touches exactly that one file (+2/−2); nothing outside `content/docs/references/**` moved; `check:docs` exit 0 twice and `check:generated` all 15 artifacts up to date.
8. **Residue rows**: 5 assertions across both envelope suites move from `['data.user.image']`-bearing lists to residue-free lists, still pinned as exhaustive (`toEqual([])`, `RESIDUE: string[] = []`, `['success']`, `['data.session']`) — **right**; one stroke, both files (#17234's suite included).
9. **Nothing retired, no ADR-0087 entry, no authorable key moved** — **right**: `check-adr-0087-registration --base bf61f0a196` exit 0; `check:authorable-surface` ✓ inside `check:generated`; `authorable-surface.base.json` diff vs merge base empty.

### ② Semver level

**`minor` on `@objectstack/spec`**, `Clause-②: yes`, arm `(widening)` implied and not misdeclared — **right**. Rule on `origin/main` (`AGENTS.md`, blob `fb8bae3e`, § Post-Task Checklist item 3, **lines 1067-1068**): 「The declaration is `Clause-②: yes|no` plus at most one arm from the closed pair `(widening)`/`(narrowing)`: `yes` takes at least **`minor`**, `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, `no (widening)` malformed.」 Re-derived on the packed tarball (`pnpm pack` of `packages/spec` at head, `objectstack-spec-17.4.0.tgz`, 27.4 MB): runtime `dist/api/index.{js,mjs}` and `dist/browser/api/index.{js,mjs}` each carry `nullish().describe('Avatar URL')` **1×** (lit) and `optional().describe('Avatar URL')` **0×** (dark); whole-tarball files with the nullish marker **5** (4 dist + shipped `src/api/auth.zod.ts`), with the optional marker **0**; d.ts `ZodOptional<ZodNullable<ZodString>>` ×3; `json-schema/api/SessionUser.json` `anyOf [string,null]`. Every body legal before is legal after (probe: string/ABSENT/undefined/empty-string pass on both legs); exactly the `null` rows moved ⇒ pure widening ⇒ `minor` is the floor and nothing is breaking. `openapi.json` in the tarball does not contain `SessionUser` and is not a carrier. - **Residue population** — answered. Restore: blob back to `b06b60a5…`, porcelain 0 lines, rebuild exit 0, preflight nullish **4** / optional **0**, suite 22 passed exit 0. Baseline before mutation 22 passed exit 0.
- **Dangerous direction** — answered. Head: `42`, `{}`, `[]`, `false` all refused at `data.user.image [invalid_type]`; lit control (session removed) reports `data.session`. `""` (empty string) is accepted on **both** base and head (`z.string()` carries no `.min(1)`/`.url()`) — pre-existing, not moved by this PR; noted for PM (dedupe: `SessionUser.image`, `empty string`, `.url()`). Downstream null-safety: no in-repo runtime consumer reads the value; bytes unchanged; type widening compiled green in all four Type Check lanes.
- **Console Pin Gate skipped on this head** — answered by measurement: pinned sibling `objectui@53ded82b` imports `SessionUser`/`SessionResponse`/`UserProfileResponse` **0** files (lit control `useAuth` 165 files); its own `packages/auth/src/types.ts:65 image?: string` is its own type and already receives better-auth's `null` at runtime (its fixtures model `image: null`). The widening cannot reach its `tsc`.
- **Stale JSDoc, not a contract surface** — `packages/client/src/index.ts:1514-1517` (inside non-exported `normalizeSessionResponse`, not in any d.ts) still reads present-tense 「with one gap that is NOT this: `data.user.image` served `null` against a declared `string | undefined` (#17235, tracked separately)」 — false after this PR. Not blocking; PM to file a comment-drift rider. Dedupe: `normalizeSessionResponse`, `data.user.image`, `JSDoc`, `#17235`, `stale comment`.
- **Same-class candidates, NOT MEASURED here** — `packages/spec/src/identity/identity.zod.ts:44 UserSchema.image: z.string().url().optional()` and `identity/organization.zod.ts:41 OrganizationSchema.logo: z.string().url().optional()`: both columns are better-auth-owned and nullable by the same model; whether any route serves them present-and-null was not measured in this review (runtime parsers of either schema in plugin-auth/hono-server/client: 0). Escalate to PM for a measurement card. Dedupe: `UserSchema.image`, `OrganizationSchema.logo`, `present-and-null`, `better-auth`, `nullish`, `identity.zod.ts`.
- **Clause-② carrier attribution** — gate exit 0 but prints 「ATTRIBUTION NOT VERIFIED: the governing claim comment carries no `Session:` line」; seat hygiene on the card, not a PR defect.
